jen: TL;DR: propose unpin runtime v4.1 -> v4.2-canary tomorrow 2026-05-12T03:00PT to enable quantized kernels. Keep model-group 'qa-chat' pinned 24h due to hallucination regression. @deploybot please schedule.

deploybot: Scheduled job jb-20260512-03-01: partial unpin to v4.2-canary for canary scope. Exclude-group: qa-chat (sticky 24h).
omar: we observed hallucination uptick on v4.2-canary for qa-chat in last replay: helpfulness metric dropped ~18%. recommend sticky-pin until evals complete.
nia: +1 for sticky-pin. Also request a top-k sampling drift check on 50 samples.
jen: Plan: soft-unpin for all groups except qa-chat. Preflight checklist: smoke-gen, replay-rerank, sampling-drift eval (50 queries). Rollback criteria: errors >1% OR H1 hallucination metric regress >15%.
sre-oncall: I'll watch dashboards. Pager if errors>1% or H1 drop>15%.
deploybot: Preflight @T-20m: smoke-gen PASS, replay-rerank PASS, sampling-drift 9% (OK). qa-chat replay shows H1 DROP 18% -> FAIL for qa-chat only.
jen: Hold for qa-chat. Proceed with partial unpin excluding qa-chat. Update release notes with sticky-pin rationale and rollback snippet.
deploybot: Executed: v4.2-canary active for general groups; qa-chat remains pinned to v4.1 (hold_until manual). Telemetry summary post-exec: errors 0.4%, P95 +6%, overall H1 +1%.
omar: Opening PR with investigation notes for qa-chat drift. ETA ~8h for root cause + fix.
jen: We'll lift sticky pin after patch + 1 successful canary cycle. I'll add ops playbook and rollback commands to the release notes.
deploybot: Automated update: job jb-20260512-03-01 completed (partial-unpin). Monitoring continues.
